segments.comment: A debug dwarvish Valkyrie wishes for iron bars on her own square, steps west off them and creates a tame sewer rat, which passes between the bars and stands on them after two searches. She then moves east into the rat three times. uhitm.c do_attack() draws rn2(7) for each safe-pet displacement, then hack.c test_move()'s IRONBARS arm returns FALSE because a dwarf cannot pass bars, so domove_core() stops before domove_swap_with_pet(), no message is printed and no time passes.

comment: hack.c test_move(): iron bars under a pet stop a displacement after do_attack()'s draw. The seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen for this case.
